start.description: Range start: an integer surface seq from mind_map (e.g. 123), or 'first' (the earliest clearable node — the system prompt never clears).

end.description: Range end: an integer surface seq from mind_map (e.g. 456), or 'latest' (everything before the current step).

notes.description: The checkpoint notes future-you needs (guidance + self-check are in the mind_map result).
